newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait Ahmadi refinery work complete end of April.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait Ahmadi refinery work complete end of April.

text.p: Maintenance work at Kuwait's main refinery at Mina al-Ahmadi will be completed by the end of April, refinery sources said on Wednesday.
"The current work does not affect throughput" of about 420,000 barrel per day (bpd), said a production official. "The maintenance is on downstream units and not crude units."
A maintenance official said the FUP (further upgrading project) work at Ahmadi started on schedule in March and is due for completion on target by the end of April.
"Depending on commitments and contracts we plan further maintenance in September and October. The plan has not been finalised yet," the official added.
The upcoming maintenance will affect production at the Kuwait National Petroleum Co refinery. Last year Ahmadi had RMP (refinery modernisation project) maintenance.
Ahmadi is a major exporter of middle distillates such as gas oil (diesel) and kerosene to Asia and the Indian subcontinent.
OPEC member Kuwait has a two million bpd quota and a refining capacity at home of about 895,000 bpd.
